notes.title: Spooky Survivors Launches on Steam – A Hand-Drawn Roguelite With a Unique Bite!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45341853/97b5a9d5c17dc3193f977de8bb55998510a81182.png[/img]

Spooky Survivors, the latest title by me, Johannes at Aligned Games, is now available on Steam. This wave-based roguelite blends chaotic survival gameplay with supernatural flair, all wrapped in a unique hand-drawn art style. For just $2.99, with a launch discount bringing it down to $2.24 until May 13, 2025, it's a compact experience that offers high replayability and a dose of quirky humor.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45341853/6197505a6009da6ec0935148b578990b479e3f0a.png[/img]

[b]Become Van Hobo, the Spooky Slayer[/b]

Players step into the shoes of Van Hobo, an unconventional monster hunter on a mission to outlast relentless waves of undead, ghosts, and nightmarish creatures. The game embraces fast-paced, skill-based survival while delivering procedural variety with every run. Whether you're chasing leaderboard glory or experimenting with different builds, Spooky Survivors gives you the freedom to play your way.

[b]Core Features[/b]

[b]All Unlocks Available from the Start[/b]

No grinding required—every ability and upgrade is accessible from the beginning, allowing you to craft builds that suit your style or the challenge ahead.

[b]Celestial Powers at Your Command[/b]

Throughout each run, you'll collect prayer crystals which can be traded for devastating abilities like meteor strikes or double damage boosts. These divine powers can shift the tide in your favor when things get overwhelming.

[b]Unique Boss Encounters[/b]

Beyond the regular waves of enemies, you’ll also face off against godlike bosses, each with their own mechanics and challenges.

[b]A Hand-Drawn Visual Identity[/b]

With a distinct visual aesthetic, every enemy, attack, and explosion pops with charm and style. The game doesn't lean on photorealism but creates an immersive tone through its playful and expressive art direction.

[b]Quirky Humor[/b]

Spooky Survivors doesn’t take itself too seriously. Van Hobo’s banter, combined with the absurdity of the world, adds levity between the intense waves of combat.

[b]Leaderboards for the Competitive[/b]

Climb the top 100 leaderboard and prove your mastery by surviving longer and scoring higher across repeated runs.

[b]Watch the Trailer[/b]

For a quick look at the gameplay in motion, check out the official trailer:

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ZDHIirBdpD4

Whether you're here for the survival challenge, the humor, or the fresh art style, Spooky Survivors delivers a punchy and affordable roguelite experience.

[b]Available Now[/b]

Spooky Survivors is available now on Steam for $2.99, with a 25% discount available until May 13:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2115040/Spooky_Survivors/

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45341853/048f8e7dd38ce9a910869a53230230c1ecde22fd.png[/img]

notes.title: Spooky Survivors coming out on the 29th of April!
notes.notes:
Spooky Survivors Launches April 29th – Grow Stronger, Survive Longer

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45341853/048f8e7dd38ce9a910869a53230230c1ecde22fd.png[/img]

In Spooky Survivors, it’s you against endless waves of monsters — and the only way to stay alive is to keep growing stronger. Defeat enemies, collect souls and prayers, and upgrade your abilities mid-run. Improve your attack speed, movement, and health, or pray to the Celestials and unlock powerful blessings that can completely reshape how you fight. Each blessing grants unique powers, from devastating lightning strikes to protective shields, letting you craft a build that fits your style.

You’ll also have access to bombs and grenades — essential tools for burning, staggering, and controlling the relentless hordes that surround you. Use them wisely to turn the tide when you’re outnumbered.

Enemy variety keeps the pressure high, with different types of monsters forcing you to constantly adapt. Some are fast, some hit hard, and others can overwhelm you in groups. No two runs feel the same.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45341853/6197505a6009da6ec0935148b578990b479e3f0a.png[/img]

You’re not just surviving — you’re evolving with every wave. Growing faster, stronger, and more relentless than the nightmares hunting you.

Spooky Survivors brings fast, ability-driven gameplay with a focus on player growth, strategic decision-making, and constant action. Build your character your way, combine upgrades and blessings, and push deeper into the chaos with every run.

Thank you for all the support so far. I’m excited for you to finally jump in and carve your own path through the living nightmare.

Spooky Survivors launches April 29th.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45341853/03102b7924eebd97b50276d1c8626c051dd2100e.png[/img]

notes.title: Full Controller Support Added
notes.notes:
In this update, I've made some major strides in improving both the user interface and gameplay mechanics. From gamepad navigation to advanced special attack mechanics, here's what I've been working on for this update.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45341853/2ac630a308a169e5539c032204976eb58c5e239a.png[/img]

[b]Gamepad Cursor Navigation[/b]

We started by adding a gamepad cursor to navigate through the UI using the right stick of a gamepad. This allows players to use their controllers more effectively, especially when interacting with menus or UI elements. With this, we’ve achieved:

Cursor Movement: The gamepad cursor moves smoothly across the screen, responding to input from the right stick. We’ve implemented controls to ensure the cursor speed is manageable and responsive.

UI Interaction: The cursor interacts with clickable UI elements, such as buttons, to trigger actions when the player presses the "Submit" button (typically the "A" button on a gamepad).

Switching Between Input Methods: We also introduced functionality to automatically detect which input method is being used—whether it’s the gamepad or the mouse. The system switches seamlessly between both methods:

Gamepad Input: When the right stick is moved, the gamepad cursor takes over, and the mouse cursor becomes hidden.

Mouse Input: If the mouse is moved or clicked, the mouse cursor is shown, and gamepad control is disabled.

This ensures a smooth transition between input devices without any additional configuration.

[b]On-Screen Keyboard Integration[/b]

One of the most exciting parts of this update was integrating the on-screen keyboard that appears when interacting with input fields (such as text boxes or name entries). The system now triggers the keyboard when a text input field is selected via the gamepad cursor. Now players can use the on-screen keyboard seamlessly for text inputs, making the game feel even more accessible.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45341853/fd32197f05b493d6ecce6ad0bcdd7c82b7ba29ee.png[/img]

[b]Updated Grenade Mechanics[/b]

In addition to the UI improvements, we’ve also made significant updates to the combat to enhance gameplay and improve the user experience:

Grenade Throwing: The throwing mechanics now allow the player to throw grenades with a more intuitive aim system. The grenade trajectory is adjusted based on the target position, either from the mouse or the gamepad cursor. This adds a more responsive feel to throwing grenades, whether the player is using a mouse or a gamepad.

Gamepad Targeting: For players using a gamepad, the target position for throwing grenades now follows the gamepad cursor, improving the control during combat. The logic has been refined to ensure the throw’s accuracy and trajectory are accurate, making for a smoother and more enjoyable gameplay experience.

Bomb Throwing: Bomb throwing mechanics have also been improved, allowing the player to throw bombs with similar precision and control as the grenades. The updated script ensures the bombs now get thrown from the correct position with an enhanced targeting system that works seamlessly with gamepad navigation.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45341853/c16a2d8aa70d7a2c0ed7744c5e577dbf7999c793.png[/img]

These changes provide a much more fluid experience, allowing players to feel in control of both their UI interactions and gameplay mechanics.

With these updates, we've made the game more accessible and enjoyable for players using gamepads while also enhancing the gameplay mechanics. The gamepad cursor system is now fully functional, and text input via the on-screen keyboard is a seamless experience. Additionally, the grenade mechanics are more responsive and fun, giving players a better sense of control during intense gameplay moments.

Stay tuned for more updates as we continue to develop and improve the game!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45341853/afc4bbeb3b35550c801fde1dacefe9481d7dd760.png[/img]

notes.title: 🎃 The Spooky Survivors Demo is Here! 🕷️
notes.notes:
Hey everyone!

I’m beyond excited to finally share the Spooky Survivors demo with you! This has been a passion project for quite some time, and now you can finally jump in and experience the chaos for yourself.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45341853/9dd37f6264d0b6c38de6c5504b1c4d980ed50fdc.png[/img]

👻 What is Spooky Survivors?

If you love fast-paced action, relentless hordes of enemies, and that perfect mix of strategy and survival, then you're in for a treat. Spooky Survivors throws you into an eerie, supernatural world where you must fight off waves of terrifying creatures while growing stronger with every encounter.

But be warned—the longer you go, the more dangerous it gets. Will you make it through, or will the horrors claim another victim?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45341853/feb4739e940d5486f660f3f7e70a5fc25b8d0bb2.png[/img]

🕹️ What’s in the Demo?

This demo gives you a first taste of what’s to come in the full game. Here’s what you can expect:

✔ Distinctive Hand-Drawn Art Style – Every frame is first hand-sketched and then digitally painted, creating a gritty, atmospheric look that sets the game apart.
✔ Intense Wave-Based Combat – Face off against relentless waves of supernatural enemies.
✔ Weapons, Pickups & Power-Ups – Experiment with different styles and abilities to find your best build.
✔ Challenging Progression – The longer you survive, the harder it gets. Adapt or perish!
✔ Eerie Atmosphere – Dark environments and chilling enemies will keep you on edge.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45341853/afc4bbeb3b35550c801fde1dacefe9481d7dd760.png[/img]

💬 Your Feedback Matters!

This is just the beginning! Your feedback will play a huge role in shaping the future of Spooky Survivors. If you find something you love, something that could be improved, or just want to share your experience, I’d love to hear from you.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45341853/5da662c051fffdf539c1009d08ef0f50e56fc14b.png[/img]

Drop your thoughts in the community, leave a review, or reach out.

Every comment helps make this game the best it can be!

I can’t wait to see how long you survive. 

Good luck… you’re going to need it. 😈

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45341853/c16a2d8aa70d7a2c0ed7744c5e577dbf7999c793.png[/img]
